title: Trump Launches Midterm Campaign Blitz Amid Record Low Approval Ratings
detail: President Trump launched an intensive midterm election campaign blitz, signaling an escalating domestic political battle ahead of November votes. The move comes as Trump's approval ratings sit near career lows — Reuters/Ipsos and Verasight polls put it at 32–33% — underscoring the political stakes as Republicans seek to defend their congressional majorities.

title: Trump Administration Signals It May Ask Europe to Release Diesel Reserves
detail: The Trump administration signaled it may ask European nations to release diesel reserves, representing a notable US intervention in European energy markets amid global supply tensions. The move reflects Washington's broader effort to manage energy prices ahead of the midterm elections while navigating a complex geopolitical environment.
